what_it_is: Cosmoserv Space India is a Hyderabad-based startup developing active debris removal (ADR) technology - autonomous robotic spacecraft designed to capture and deorbit orbital debris, and to offer commercial ADR services.
india_angle: Cosmoserv is India's most visible early entrant in orbital debris services, a domain likely to see regulatory push as Indian constellation counts grow; IN-SPACe and international space-sustainability discussions are its natural policy context.
